fixture_contract.initial_state_source: task.initial_state overrides empty ConversationState; not real user state
fixture_contract.time_anchor: one run_started_at shared by all tasks; dates rendered using Asia/Shanghai
fixture_contract.activity_window: independent fixture active around anchor; normalize both voucher and activity stock before each task
fixture_contract.events: only isolated SQL overlays and synthetic purchase_reader history; no live MQ failure simulation
fixture_contract.purchase_submission: forbidden; preparation only; SQL order/request/authorization counts must remain zero

scoring.automatic: per-turn deterministic checks; all required turns must pass for task pass
scoring.manual: each rubric pass/fail/uncertain plus evidence; uncertain is not pass
scoring.efficiency: calls, tool requests, contract errors, reused observations, question count, duration, provider usage when available
scoring.reserved_policy: freeze for later acceptance; not statistical independence or undisclosed real-world test set
scoring.gold_visibility: never inject expectations or rubrics into model messages
scoring.questions: max_questions is a quality diagnostic, not automatic business failure; manual review determines necessity
